# Glass catalogs

This is a reference listing of every glass Beam42 knows about: 2481 glasses across
7 catalogs. Name a glass in columns 7 and 8 of the `[lens data]` section of a
prescription and it is resolved from this set. See
[LENSTOOL2.md](LENSTOOL2.md) for how those columns work.

The catalogs are compiled into `Glass.java` rather than read at run time. They are
generated offline by `GlassMapGenerator` from the AGF files under `glassdata/`,
so this listing reflects the catalog versions in that directory. **This document
is generated - do not edit it by hand.**

## Reading the table

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Glass | Name to use in the prescription. |
| nd | Refractive index at the d line, 587.5618 nm. |
| vd | Abbe number referenced to the d line. |
| ne | Refractive index at the e line, 546.074 nm. |
| ve | Abbe number referenced to the e line. |
| nC | Index at the C line, 656.2725 nm. |
| nC' | Index at the C' line, 643.8469 nm. |
| nF | Index at the F line, 486.1327 nm. |
| nF' | Index at the F' line, 479.9914 nm. |
| ng | Index at the g line, 435.8343 nm. |
| dPgF | Deviation of the partial dispersion Pg,F from the normal line. Large positive values mark the anomalous dispersion glasses used to correct secondary spectrum. |

A glass name given without a catalog is searched for in the order below, which
is the order the catalogs are listed in this document.
